'''2001 Brugge Belgian Open''' was a Decipher-era constructed event. Published lists from this event are the 60s Decipher posted on Deck Designs.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Dates:''' 3 March 2001<ref name="tr-d1839" />
* '''Players:''' 54<ref name="tr-d1839" />
* '''Site:''' Brugge, Belgium<ref name="tr-d1839" />

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* The hub lists Bastian Winkelhaus as 1st (and the List gives him as winner), but Riviere's report says he was the only undefeated player and beat Winkelhaus in the last round to win Saturday's individual event; Decipher's own Brugge deck-design introduction also says Riviere took first in Saturday's 54-player constructed event.<ref name="tr-d1839" />
